post.description: Create a new consumer session by authenticating with email and password. Returns access and refresh tokens for subsequent requests.

put.description:
Update a consumer session with new access and refresh tokens (used for automatic login and token refresh).

**IMPORTANT:** This endpoint requires valid tokens from a previous login. You must:
1. First call POST /sessions to login and receive real tokens
2. Copy the accessToken and refreshToken from the login response
3. Use those exact tokens in both the Authorization header and request body
4. The tokens are validated against the cache - fake tokens will fail with 401

delete.description: Delete a consumer session from the system (archive and remove from cache). Requires JWT access token in Authorization header.
